definition_en: Text format containing sequencing reads and per-base quality scores
definition_zh: 包含测序 reads 及逐碱基质量分数的文本格式

definition_en: Per-file quality-control program for common sequencing quality patterns
definition_zh: 用于检查常见测序质量模式的单文件质控程序

definition_en: Read preprocessing tool for adapter trimming, quality filtering, and clean-read reporting
definition_zh: 用于接头剪切、质量过滤和 clean-read 报告的 reads 预处理工具

definition_en: Aggregator that collects many bioinformatics QC outputs into one report
definition_zh: 将多个生信 QC 输出汇总为一个报告的聚合工具

definition_en: A report whose main CSS, JavaScript, and embedded QC payload index are stored in one HTML file
definition_zh: 主 CSS、JavaScript 和内嵌 QC payload 索引存于同一个 HTML 文件中的报告
